records.product: Orange Pink Wildflower Peel and Stick Wallpaper (Etsy 4591093497)
records.caption:
Stuck with bare walls you can't paint?

Wildflowers in a single peel-and-stick sheet change the whole room in one afternoon: no tools, no paint, no mess. Picture waking up to a soft cottage-garden wall that feels like yours, and peeling it off when you move out. 🌸

• Orange poppies, pink and lilac wildflowers on a warm peach background
• 17.7 x 118 in (45 x 300 cm) panels
• Peel-and-stick: wipe the wall, peel, stick from top to bottom and smooth with the included scraper

Link in the first comment. $14.99 on Etsy.
